assertions.description: color() accepts the display-p3-linear predefined color space with three numeric components.
Components may be percentages, equivalent to the 0–1 number range.
An optional alpha follows the slash, as in every color() space.
Values outside 0–1 are permitted at parse time; color() components are not clamped.
The none keyword is valid for a missing component.
The predefined-RGB grammar requires three components; two must not parse.
display-p3-linear is usable as the destination space in relative color syntax.
assertions.test: color: color(from red display-p3-linear r g b)

assertions.description: A display-p3-linear background survives to getComputedStyle and serializes in its own color space.
assertions.test: (() => { const el = document.createElement('div'); document.body.append(el); el.style.backgroundColor = 'color(display-p3-linear 0.25 0.5 0.75)'; const got = getComputedStyle(el).backgroundColor; el.remove(); return got.includes('display-p3-linear'); })()

assertions.description: Converting display-p3-linear 0.5 grey to display-p3 yields the spec transfer curve's 0.73536 (1.055·0.5^(1/2.4) − 0.055), within 0.005.
assertions.test: (() => { const el = document.createElement('div'); document.body.append(el); el.style.color = 'color(from color(display-p3-linear 0.5 0.5 0.5) display-p3 r g b)'; const got = getComputedStyle(el).color; el.remove(); const m = got.match(/color\(display-p3\s+([\d.eE+-]+)/); return !!m && Math.abs(Number(m[1]) - 0.735357) < 0.005; })()

assertions.description: Full-intensity linear red converts to display-p3 1 0 0 exactly — same primaries, only the transfer differs.
assertions.test: (() => { const el = document.createElement('div'); document.body.append(el); el.style.color = 'color(from color(display-p3-linear 1 0 0) display-p3 r g b)'; const got = getComputedStyle(el).color; el.remove(); const m = got.match(/color\(display-p3\s+([\d.eE+-]+)\s+([\d.eE+-]+)\s+([\d.eE+-]+)/); return !!m && Math.abs(Number(m[1]) - 1) < 0.001 && Math.abs(Number(m[2])) < 0.001 && Math.abs(Number(m[3])) < 0.001; })()
